title: GoDB overview
description: Local Raft group, engine persistence and runtime. Missing proposal data is expected until a workload submits commands. Metrics do not prove quorum or linearizable reads.

panels.title: Scrape availability
panels.description: 1 = reachable, 0 = failed scrape. This is not a quorum/readiness test.

panels.title: Observed leader
panels.description: 1 = locally reports leader. Check progress and scrape availability; this does not prove quorum.

panels.title: Open connections per member
panels.description: All accepted MySQL client TCP connections plus established peer and monitoring connections. MySQL includes handshakes; the session panel counts authenticated clients only.

panels.title: Open connections by kind
panels.description: peer_inbound / peer_outbound are established gRPC transports after TLS; metrics_http includes scrape and health-check sockets. Failed handshakes are excluded.

panels.title: Peak connections by kind
panels.description: Per-kind high-water mark since this member started. Summing these peaks is not a simultaneous cluster peak.

panels.title: Connection churn / second
panels.description: Health checks also open and close metrics HTTP connections. Counters exclude failed TCP/TLS establishment.

panels.title: Proposal outcomes / second
panels.description: Local proposal calls, including retries and timeouts. Empty until commands are submitted through the Go API.

panels.title: Proposal caller p99
panels.description: Includes queue and commit wait; all outcomes. Empty until proposals occur.

panels.title: Persistence errors in selected interval
panels.description: Raft store errors also include invalid Save updates, not only disk errors.

panels.title: Storage size
panels.description: Last successfully persisted/recovered sizes. Does not include WAL, all filesystem use, or available disk space.

panels.title: Engine key operations / second
panels.description: Includes internal replication metadata. These are not normalized SQL/query counts.

panels.title: Engine request p99
panels.description: Raw Get only; typed lookups/scans do not all use this path.

panels.title: Observed leader changes
panels.description: Counts local leader-ID changes including transitions through unknown.

panels.title: Peer RPCs in flight
panels.description: RPC concurrency, not connection count. A single HTTP/2 connection carries multiple RPCs; outbound wait-for-ready time is included.

panels.title: Peer payload bandwidth
panels.description: gRPC payload bytes plus framing; excludes headers and TCP/TLS overhead. Aggregating both directions across a cluster counts each payload at both ends.

panels.title: Peer RPC error ratio
panels.description: Non-OK completed calls / started calls over the window. Includes cancellations; no traffic produces no ratio.

targets.expr: sum by (member, kind) (rate(godb_peer_rpc_errors_total{job="godb",member=~"$member"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (member, kind) (rate(godb_peer_rpc_started_total{job="godb",member=~"$member"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Active writes and transactions
panels.description: Writes include queue wait. Transactions count explicit BeginWrite handles until Commit finishes or Rollback; not replicated commands or automatic batches.

panels.title: Write scheduling delay p99
panels.description: Enqueue attempt to batch dispatch, including channel backpressure and batching; excludes database lock acquisition and execution.

panels.title: Explicit transaction outcomes / second
panels.description: Only explicit WriteTx handles. Empty/no-op successful commits count; repeated Commit/Rollback calls do not. Replicated commands use applied-command metrics.

panels.title: Explicit transaction lifetime p99
panels.description: BeginWrite through Commit completion or Rollback, including application think time. No observations until explicit transactions finish.

panels.title: Page I/O bandwidth
panels.description: Page-store calls times page size. Reads can hit the OS cache; these are not device IOPS/bytes. Excludes WAL and Raft journal.

panels.title: Replication apply lag
panels.description: Local commit-minus-apply distance in entries, not seconds or follower distance from the leader. Cached after event-loop progress; a stalled loop can make this stale.

panels.title: Process file descriptors
panels.description: All process file descriptors, including database files and sockets. Not a connection count; availability depends on the OS.

panels.title: SQL and consistent reads
SQL statements / second
panels.description: SQL executions by kind and outcome. SELECT/COUNT supports point lookups, primary and secondary-index ranges, equality prefixes, and bounded table scans. Residual comparisons and NULL tests filter captured rows. INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE maintain indexes atomically. EXPLAIN reports statement=explain and returns a plan without executing the SELECT.

panels.title: SQL statement p99
panels.description: SQL execution p99 includes candidate reads, equality filtering, in-memory sorting, and result slicing; preparation is measured separately. The 1,024-candidate work bound also applies to queries with LIMIT. EXPLAIN latency covers plan rendering and server read-barrier wait, without user-row scans; preparation is separate.

panels.title: SQL statements in flight
panels.description: SQL through the server Go API: execution excludes preparation. Series appear after use; affected rows count successful retry responses as well as initial responses.

panels.title: SQL rows / second
panels.description: Rows returned after SELECT filtering and LIMIT; affected rows count INSERTs, changed UPDATEs, and DELETEs; matched rows count UPDATE matches including unchanged rows; deleted rows count successful removals. Successful retries retain original counts. CLIENT_FOUND_ROWS changes wire counts only. COUNT contributes its returned result row, not the value of the count. EXPLAIN contributes one returned plan row without executing the described query.

panels.title: SQL preparation p99
panels.description: Parsing, quorum-confirmed catalog access, table-ID selection and parameter binding; separate from execution.

panels.title: Consistent read p99
panels.description: Queue, quorum confirmation, application wait and local catalog/row work.

panels.title: Read barriers and queue
panels.description: Pending includes canceled barriers retained until acknowledgement or a leadership change. Limits: 128 pending, 32 queued.

panels.title: Consistent read outcomes / second
panels.description: Catalog preparation and SELECT read calls, including rejection, cancellation and overload outcomes.

panels.title: MySQL client connections and sessions
panels.description: Only exported when the opt-in MySQL listener is enabled. TCP includes TLS/authentication and idle clients.

panels.title: MySQL authentication and admission errors / second
panels.description: Handshake failures include TLS, malformed login, credential and database-selection errors. Admission rejects before authentication.

panels.title: MySQL connection churn / second
panels.description: Accepted MySQL TCP connection lifecycle, including unsuccessful authentication.

panels.title: MySQL prepared statement handles
panels.description: Open handles across authenticated client connections. Limit: 128 per connection; disconnect releases all handles.

panels.title: MySQL prepared statement bytes
panels.description: Retained SQL text and long parameter data, excluding allocation/metadata overhead. Limits per connection: 1 MiB SQL, 128 KiB parameter chunks.

panels.title: MySQL prepare and execute / second
panels.description: Prepare attempts and executions for known handles, including failures. Prepare does not mutate rows.

panels.title: MySQL statement errors / second
panels.description: Prepared statement error responses, including capacity, framing, parameter binding and SQL errors.

panels.title: MySQL session activity / second
panels.description: Local session SQL executions and errors, plus successful connection resets. These do not access Raft and are separate from database SQL latency.

panels.title: MySQL schema discovery / second
panels.description: SHOW discovery and all six INFORMATION_SCHEMA views, including primary/unique constraint discovery: execution attempts and errors before result encoding; excludes prepare descriptions.

panels.title: MySQL catalog read p95
panels.description: Catalog access for SHOW and INFORMATION_SCHEMA, including constraint views, during prepare and execution. Includes quorum and local reads; outcomes include success and errors.

panels.title: SELECT access paths / second
panels.description: Prepared SELECT executions by access path and outcome. Point lookups take priority, then primary_range, secondary-index prefixes/ranges, and table_scan. index_range binds a leading equality/IS NULL prefix and ranges over the next column; ranged NULL values do not match. NULL-containing equality prefixes use index_scan. The 1,024 candidate cap applies inside the chosen range before residual filtering and LIMIT. Includes short circuits and quorum failures; excludes preparation failures. EXPLAIN is excluded because it does not execute the SELECT.

panels.title: Aggregate SELECT / second
panels.description: Prepared COUNT executions by outcome, including empty primary/secondary ranges, NULL short circuits, suppressed results, and quorum failures. Counts use the selected point/range/scan snapshot. The candidate cap applies inside the selected range before residual filtering and aggregation. Measures executions, not counted rows. EXPLAIN SELECT COUNT is excluded because no aggregation runs.
SQL execution, quorum-confirmed reads, and optional MySQL client sessions.
